coveragePolicy.note: Raise only after an intentional baseline refresh with nx run korfbal-django:test:ci.

options.command: uv run ruff format --check apps/django_projects/korfbal && uv run ruff check apps/django_projects/korfbal

commands.command: KORFBAL_TEST_DB_LANE=general uv run python scripts/python/run_pytest_target.py -- --nomigrations -q -n 2 --dist loadgroup -m 'not migration_regression' apps/django_projects/korfbal

KORFBAL_TEST_DB_LANE=migrations uv run python scripts/python/run_pytest_target.py -- -q -n 2 --dist load apps/django_projects/korfbal/apps/game_tracker/tests/test_tracker_command_migration.py apps/django_projects/korfbal/apps/schedule/tests/test_mvp_state_migration.py apps/django_projects/korfbal/korfbal/tests/test_audit_migrations.py

KORFBAL_TEST_DB_LANE=general PYTHONPATH=.:${PYTHONPATH} uv run pytest -p configs.pytest_plugins.django_projects --django-project korfbal --nomigrations -q -n 3 --dist loadgroup -m 'not migration_regression' apps/django_projects/korfbal --cov=apps/django_projects/korfbal/apps --cov=apps/django_projects/korfbal/korfbal --cov-config=apps/django_projects/korfbal/.coveragerc --cov-report=term:skip-covered --cov-report=xml:reports/coverage/coverage-korfbal.xml --cov-fail-under=83

KORFBAL_TEST_DB_LANE=migrations PYTHONPATH=.:${PYTHONPATH} uv run pytest -p configs.pytest_plugins.django_projects --django-project korfbal -q apps/django_projects/korfbal/apps/game_tracker/tests/test_tracker_command_migration.py apps/django_projects/korfbal/apps/schedule/tests/test_mvp_state_migration.py apps/django_projects/korfbal/korfbal/tests/test_audit_migrations.py
